$comment: The feats a level-up can grant in place of an Ability Score Improvement (the Baldur's Gate 3 list; add {"feat": id} to a class's progression in classes.json to grant one outright). Every feat is listed in the level panel; one whose requirement the hero does not meet is greyed out, and one the game does not play out yet (worked: false) is greyed out too. Fields (all optional): worked: the game plays it out. abilities: the abilities it raises by 1 (the player picks one when there are several; never above 20). requires: {armor: light|medium|heavy|shield} trained in that armour (by class or by another feat), {spellcaster: true} the hero casts spells, {abilityAtLeast: {abilities: [..], score: n}} one of those abilities at n or more. initiative: added to initiative rolls. hitPointsPerLevel: hit points every level, those of levels already gained too. armor: armour training it gives. mediumArmorDexCap: the DEX that medium armour lets count. heavyArmorReduction: damage taken off every enemy weapon blow while in heavy armour. speedFeet: feet of speed it adds. passivePerception: added to passive Perception. saveProficiency: trained in the saving throw of the ability it raised. savageDamage: weapon damage dice are rolled twice, the higher kept. dualWield: two-weapon fighting without light weapons (not heavy ones), and dualWieldArmorClass more AC with a melee weapon in each hand. unarmedStrengthTwice: STR counts twice to hit and to damage bare-handed. shortRestFullHeal: a short rest heals every hit point. passive: a Passive Feat, listed in its own section of the Skills tab - toggle (bound to the quick bar, its key switches it on and off) or auto (works by itself when its moment comes). powerAttack: heavy_melee or ranged - while switched on, -5 to hit and +10 damage with such a weapon the hero is proficient with. bonusAttack: a critical hit or a kill with a melee weapon adds an attack to the next swing. duelist: with a finesse weapon the hero is proficient with, an enemy melee blow that the proficiency bonus added to AC would turn aside misses (then 30 s to recover). rangedBonusAttack: a kill with a ranged weapon adds a shot to the next volley. alert: initiative is rolled even against a foe nobody sees coming (else it strikes first). pitLeap: the hero never falls into a pit; they leap over it, or spring back from its edge. charge (with passive active and cooldown, seconds): used from the quick bar, a rush at the foe nearest the aim and a weapon attack. magicFind: percentage points more chance that gear found in a chest is magical. mageSlayer: advantage on saving throws against spells of a foe within melee reach. polearm: with a glaive, halberd, pike, quarterstaff or spear every swing adds a 1d4 bludgeoning blow with the butt end. shieldSaves: added to Dexterity saving throws while carrying a shield. picks: what the player chooses in a box once the feat is picked - {cantrips, spells, from (a class's list), ability (cast with), damaging (only damaging cantrips)}, {weapons: n} weapons to be trained in (those the hero is trained in already are greyed out), or {element: [types]} one damage type. New effects need a field here, a reader in src/rules/Feats.ts and a hook where the rule applies. Names and descriptions: texts.json, feat.<id>.name/description.
